label: Some necessary concretum is supported somewhere by a concretum absent from an accessible world
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed (motivated by bottom-up grounding of a necessary whole in replaceable constituents): for some admitted world v and concrete candidates a and b, a exists at v, b exists at every world accessible from w, a stands to b in the selected relation at v, and a is absent from some world accessible from w. It does not say that b is supported at w itself or at every world.
